Sync published changes to GitHub

Download published text, box styles and banners. The export excludes drafts, UID submissions and private moderation history.

In your GitHub folder, run this with the downloaded file path. It checks changes without writing:

node scripts/sync-admin-content.mjs --file "path/to/export.json"

Add --apply to back up and update the files. Review the Git diff, run the build, then commit/push. After deployment, apply the generated SQL in supabase/sync to update editor defaults without replacing newer edits.

        Create a local audit report

        Capture the current baseline, prepare the next version’s reviewed guide-data files locally, capture a second snapshot, then compare them. Raw Lua, APKs and private player records stay outside the public website.

        node scripts/audit-game-version.mjs --capture --version 0.49.1

        See docs/VERSION-AUDIT-WORKFLOW.md for the complete commands. Snapshots and reports stay in the ignored .game-audits folder.
